# 02-Briefs/

Output of the Reflective Council. `/daily-brief` (07:00) and `/weekly-brief` (Sun 08:05) write here.

## Structure

```
02-Briefs/
├── daily/
│   └── 2026-04-21.md
└── weekly/
    └── 2026-W17.md
```

## Daily brief shape (auto-generated)

- Active Gate
- Top 3 Moves (each paired with ⚔️ COUNTER verdict)
- Pattern Cluster distribution yesterday
- Cross-Brand Link (Connector role)
- Creative Sparks
- Energy × Drift snapshot

## Weekly brief shape (auto-generated)

- This week's thesis (1 paragraph)
- What shipped (with Move Shipped Date audit)
- Council hit rate
- Counter-Coach wins
- Pattern of the week
- Promoted prompts (Library additions)
- Off-gate items
- Next week's Gate

## Rules

- Never edited by hand — briefs are Council artifacts
- Mirror to Obsidian daily note via `/capture --daily` sidebar
- Weekly briefs publishable to OSS via `/ship-public --weekly-brief`
- Skinny-beats-skipped: if Council produces <3 moves, output fewer, never fake

See [[../00-MOCs/MOC-Council]] and [[../meta/prompt-os-v1.4.0-architecture]].
